_comment: NativeLink cache endpoint reference profiles (DATA, not engine policy). Reviewed reference only — no live gate or materializer enforces these values since the ci/facade/build-cache-policy gate crate was retired on dev (#1960); the hand-maintained consumers (infra/ci/buckconfig/warm-cache-{ro,rw}.buckconfig overlays and the storage/adapters/nativelink/nativelink-cas.k8s.yaml Service/NetworkPolicy bindings) must be updated in the same change whenever this file is edited and kept in agreement by review. Pinned grammar is grpc:// plus a DNS-LDH host (no IPv6 or trailing dot) and a canonical nonzero decimal u16 port; the socket form omits only the grpc:// prefix. Credentials and certificate material never belong here.
